category_id.label: Category ID
category_id.description: Leave empty: the page shows the category being viewed (all hierarchs, or one hierarch). Enter an ID only to preview in the builder.

title.label: Title
title.description: Leave empty for Pastoral letters / Pastorale / Cartas pastorales in the page language.

intro.label: Intro
intro.description: Leave empty for the standard sentence in the page language.

part.label: Show
part.description: The page header (breadcrumb, title, intro) is built with YOOtheme elements; this block then shows only the part chosen here.
